title: The best Armstrong period: the Hot Five; Billie Holiday and the blues singers
summary: Alcorn praises the Hot Five as unmatched, and the talk turns to pattern-setting singers such as Billie Holiday, Bessie Smith and Ma Rainey.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: What do you think was the best period of his musical career? When was the, when were the best years when he played music? What do you think?

Well, Louis had so many good, good, mixed in spots. Because I was crazy about, first thing everybody was crazy about the Hot Five. Never had another thing like that. Everybody tried to organize things, but they never got them close to the Hot Five. The Oriole and Johnny Giles. Yeah.
Little St. Cyr I think was in the place.

Johnny St. Cyr, yeah. And they never, guys copy their records a day. Something that, even if they played a solo just like him, it's not those guys. Sam Ray Orr, Orr has got things on the drum hall. Jack Keegan on the room used to come sit down and listen to him. He said, old man, that's it. He used to speak about, Trumma Young used to come follow us around all the time. He said, Orr, you got something. What does this old man have? He said, the guys just had something happen. It was just what you call leaders. You know, guys, what they're doing, it was guys that everybody could set a pattern out.
I think Billie Holiday was that way as a singer.

Yeah, quite a few people set patterns after Billie Holiday. Billie Holiday came in the late years. Billie Holiday came in the school president. I'm sorry. During the time of, my time or something. She wasn't old as me when she died. I'm just saying, you know.
She was that same kind of natural though as an artist, don't you?
I came through with that. But the one that said everything was Bessie Smith and other people. See, back in those days we had blues singers like Bessie Smith. Ma Rainey.
Paul Rainey and all the women like that. Yeah. They really were setting pace for blues. And that's how these young singers like Billie Holiday had one pattern out there.
